_comment: Canonical, reviewable lock of the PGDG-sourced PostgreSQL 18 client closure installed by apps/api/Dockerfile. It pins the packages that are NOT provided by the fixed python:3.12-slim base image digest, so APT can never silently resolve a different closure (e.g. a newer libpq5). The base libraries (libc6, liblz4-1, libreadline8t64, libssl3t64, libzstd1, zlib1g, sensible-utils) come from the pinned base image digest and are NOT re-installed here; their file-level identity (path + sha256 + owning package + version) is measured inside the image and bound to build-provenance.json via postgresql_runtime_files / postgresql_runtime_manifest_hash. dependency_closure_hash = sha256(canonical_json({architecture,codename,distribution,packages}) + '\n'). The build FAILS closed if an installed version differs from this lock or if this hash does not match; there is no fallback and no automatic regeneration.
